blurb: See Washington and nearby Maryland dressed in spring color on a seasonal small group cherry blossom tour. Visit the Thomas Jefferson Memorial and East Potomac Park before continuing to Kenwood, a residential neighborhood known for streets lined with Yoshino cherry trees. Enjoy time to walk beneath the blossoms and take photos, with bottled water and a snack provided. A reserved ticket for a self-guided visit to the National Air and Space Museum on the following day is also included.
